li.label: whispers of Ruin
li.description: Something scratches at the edges of thought. Faint, insistent, patient. It knows my name.

li.label: urges of Ruin
li.description: The voice is clearer now. It suggests things. Violent things. Helpful things. It is difficult to tell the difference.

li.label: Ruin's grip
li.description: There are moments when the hands move on their own. Moments when the thoughts are not mine. Ruin does not ask permission.

li.label: spiritually hollow
li.description: Something fundamental is missing. The world feels muted, distant, as though seen through smoked glass. There is a hollowness where something vital once resided.
